The low nibble of a cell selects its block type through the table at $073E. Columns 0 to 3 hold 00 01 02 03; the rest of the strip is zero.

192 bytes ($0640-$06FF) after the 64-cell strip, all zero. The position mask $5E is $FF in this scene ($59A1 indexed by header byte $0705 = 0), so columns 64 to 255 reach these bytes; whether the scene's bounds keep the player inside the first 64 columns was not checked.

Start of the 32-byte scene header that the loader at $557A unpacks after the map. The bytes are $50 38 2D 2D 01 00 00 00 09 0D 0D 0D 0D 0D 55 38. The loader reads $0701 ($38, "8") as the name character of the picture P and character set C resources it loads to $BC00 and $E000, $070F ($38, "8") as the name character of the overlay U loaded to $8B00, and $0703 ($2D, "-") as the extra costume selector, where a dash means none. $0700 and $0702 are not read by the loader.

Three numeric header bytes: $0704 (1) is the loop limit the loader compares at $568F and is read by the camera and motion routines ($287C, $3447, $4409, $48C6); the resident also stores to it at $6B9E. $0705 (0) indexes the tables at $59A1 and $59A8 that set $5E, $5F and $60 ($FF and $00 here), and from $566A $0706 (0) is shifted right twice into $02C8 (0), its low two bits going to bits 7-6 of $02C7.

Seven colour bytes ($0707-$070D = 00 09 0D 0D 0D 0D 0D) read by $5A34: $0708 and $0709 go to the VIC background colour registers $D022 and $D023, $0707 is cached at $02DD as the display colour, and $070A-$070D are copied to the four message palette bytes $6998-$699B unless $0387 and $26 are both negative ($5A46-$5A4D then skip to $5A6D).
Two bytes, "U8" ($55 $38): the overlay resource name, whose second character the loader compares with its cache at $508E and loads at $8B00 ($070F).

Ten bytes ($0710-$0719 = 00 12 2C 4A 58 68 76 00 00 00): depth thresholds. The table is read indexed from $0710 by the object grid and placement routines at $28CA, $37B9 (in $37B4), $383F, $3863 and $5487; $0711 is read at $548A, $0718 at $5397 and $0719 at $53B9.

Costume selector ($02), read at $51EA and copied to $02C5 (replaced by 4 when $0385 is non-negative and $0565 is negative); it indexes the initial-animation table at $5985, read at $520D. The three bytes after it ($071B-$071D = 34 29 FF) are read at $5201, $5207 and $51E4 when entry placement starts.

Sixteen low-nibble-to-type values read indexed by the resident at $351E, $3565, $3B5A (in $3B51), $4192 (in $4173), $4A8E, $4B27, $4F7D, $4F99, $4FE8 and $503E (bytes: 0F 0F 0F 0F 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01). Sixteen inclusive upper column bounds read by $4115 (bytes: FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF). Resident $411C takes the first entry whose bound is at least the coarse column, so each region is the span of columns up to its bound.

Sixteen bytes ($075E-$076D = 03 03 03 03 03 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00) between the column thresholds and the selectors. The scan at $411C reads at most index 14 ($075C), so it reads none of them. The resident uses $075E,X/Y as per-cell state for special map cells: $381C increments the counter of the cell just entered, and $38FE (update_grid_special_cell) reads and writes it at $3901 and $3915, with Y the low nibble of a special map cell.

Sixteen source selectors, one per region (bytes: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00). Resident $412B reads the one for the region found at $411C: 0 uses the region itself as the table index (bank 0), 1 takes bits $60 of the state byte $0500, 2 takes bits $60 of $0501, and 3 or more take bits $60 of the shared PRNG.
